• The number of Mathematics students from 2015-2018 = 38
 
• The number of Physics students from 2015-2018 = 26
 
• The number of Chemistry students from 2015-2018 = 20
 
• The number of Zoology students from 2015-2018 = 18
 
• The number of Botany students from 2015-2018 = 10

The total number of students passed with Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Zoology, and Botony from year 2015-18 = No. of Mathematics students + No. of Physics students + No. of Chemistry students + No. of Zoology students + No. of Botany students

= 38 + 26 + 20 + 18 + 10

= 112

**Hence, the students passed Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Zoology, and Botony from the year 2015-18 112.**
